svg.title: Pipeline warm board-game UI with movable decoration tray
svg.desc: A faithful desktop layout of the current two-panel Pipeline interface in a warm cream, olive, teal and copper board-game style. Six separate decoration objects are parked in a tray on the right for manual placement.

g.text: Choose one tile, then adjacent tiles
Choose all pipes first. Selected pieces remain unconfirmed until purchase.

g.inkscape:label: Movable decoration tray
g.text: Each ornament is a separate movable SVG object.
Move decoration groups only; the UI layer stays intact.
